page: Microsoft Azure E20ds_v7 is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine from the Edsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 20 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 10 physical Intel Xeon 6973P-C cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and is equipped with a 480 MB L3 cache. It includes advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions for tile and INT8 operations.

The server is configured with 160.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Storage capabilities include a bundled 1181 GB local NVMe SSD, and the instance is Premium Storage capable. No GPU accelerators are included in this configuration.

In benchmark testing, the E20ds_v7 demonstrates strong single-core performance, scoring in the top 25% for Geekbench single-core and single-threaded gzip compression. Multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics generally fall within the average range, with a Passmark CPU score of 33317.5 and uncached large-block memory read bandwidth of 141.96 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET performance also align with average tier expectations, registering 10336.74 operations and 34.81 million operations per second, respectively.

Given its high memory density and integrated local NVMe storage, the E20ds_v7 offers a balanced cost-to-resource profile for memory-intensive workloads without requiring separate storage attachments. This configuration is well-suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems like Redis, data analytics, and memory-heavy enterprise applications.
